phases.title: Phase 0 — Foundation

items.text: Extend hris-python/backend scaffold (settings, Postgres engine, Alembic)
PyJWT + pwdlib auth: access + refresh tokens, real logout/revocation
Rate limiting on login/reset endpoints
require_permission(module, action) RBAC dependency, enforced on every route
Seed modules/submodules/role codes
Base response model, pagination, error format, audit middleware

testsRequired: Auth flow: login / refresh / logout / expired-token rejection
RBAC dependency: low-privilege token blocked from gated route
Rate-limit trigger test
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 1 — Employee core + Org structure

items.text: EmployeeRecords + additional records + attachments
Department, Division, Subdivision, Position CRUD
Construction/manpower domain: Project, Phase, Blocks, Lots, Model, ModelTypes, Owner, Category
EmployeeProjects, EmpTask
Users/UserType CRUD gated by enforced RBAC
Dashboard KPI endpoints

testsRequired: CRUD tests per resource (create/read/update/soft-delete)
Test confirming a user cannot escalate their own role
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 2A — Attendance/DTR time math core

items.text: Shared calculation module: rendered minutes, late, undertime, absence, OT
Documented decision on lunch deduction (fixed vs configurable)

testsRequired: Unit tests against hand-defined expected values for each scenario class: on-time, late, undertime, absent, with/without OT, with lunch deduction
Boundary tests: exact-boundary late minutes, zero-render days
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 2B — Sync + endpoints + approval flow

items.text: Biometric sync reader (parameterized queries)
DTR adjustment approval flow
Overtime approval with role gate

testsRequired: Sync reader tested against a mock device DB
Approval-flow state transition tests
Permission gate test on approval endpoints
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 3 — Leave & Holidays

items.text: LeavePolicy, YearlyEmployeeLeave, SelectedEmployeeLeaves ledger
Leave request lifecycle + approval, server-authoritative actor
Idempotent approval (no double-debit on re-approval)
Holiday configuration + date-check, explicit holiday pay decision
Decide: keep no-accrual/no-carryover, or modernize the ledger

testsRequired: Ledger math tests (accrual/deduction per defined policy)
Idempotency test: approve same request twice results in single debit
Actor-spoofing test: client-supplied updated_by is ignored/overridden
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 4A — Government contribution calculators

items.text: SSS calculator as standalone function
PhilHealth calculator as standalone function
Pag-IBIG calculator as standalone function
BIR withholding tax calculator as standalone function
Verify all four against current official published bracket tables

testsRequired: One test per bracket boundary (just under / at / just over each threshold) for all four calculators
At least one official worked example per calculator where published
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 4B — Payroll generation

items.text: Shared function for both preview and generation (no divergence)
Explicit semi-monthly dues halving policy, implemented once
Loan amortization logic
13th-month calculation
Payroll groups (cutoff windows), payslip, YTD

testsRequired: Preview and generation return identical output for the same input
Loan amortization correctness tests
13th-month formula tests
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 4C — Verification gate

items.text: Define payroll test scenarios: salary bands × loans × OT × cutoff type
Manually verify expected net pay per scenario
Check scenario suite into the codebase as the permanent regression suite

testsRequired: 100% of defined payroll scenarios pass — this is a hard gate, Phase 6 cannot start until this is complete
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 5 — Notifications, Audit, Reports, Polish

items.text: In-app + email notifications, no hardcoded recipients
Audit trail redacts sensitive fields, is queryable
Any additional reports

testsRequired: Audit log redaction test: confirm no plaintext password is ever written
Notification trigger tests
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 6 — Data Migration & Cutover

items.text: Clean new schema (sensible snake_case names, no legacy artifacts)
ETL script with documented column mapping, legacy MySQL (read-only) → new Postgres
Historical payroll records migrate as read-only, not recalculated under new rules

testsRequired: ETL row-count/checksum validation per table
Spot-check test that migrated historical payroll records are untouched by new calculation logic
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete

phases.title: Phase 7 — Hardening

items.text: Pen-test the Phase 0 auth/RBAC fixes
Load test payroll generation
Backup/restore drill
Remove legacy system

testsRequired: Automated authorization test suite: every gated route tested with a low-privilege token
Load test with defined pass/fail thresholds
Backup/restore drill documented as a repeatable test
phases.definitionOfDone: All tests above pass before phase is marked complete
